5. Repeat the AI Astra attribution and score/PYQ positioning in the existing hub header and explainer; do not duplicate the full flagship banner into the hub.
6. Do not modify dates, timings, streak counters, or action buttons.
7. Ensure full responsive layout compatibility on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800).
8. Add proper kebab-case data-testid attributes for all new banner elements.

Maintain high APCA/WCAG AA contrast for text over dark or colorful gradient surfaces.
